name: DESIGN.md
summary: A file format that describes a design system to coding agents: design tokens plus markdown rationale.
description: DESIGN.md is a format specification from Google Labs for describing a visual identity to coding agents: machine-readable design tokens in YAML front matter (colors, typography, dimensions, component tokens) combined with human-readable design rationale in ordered markdown sections. It ships a linter CLI (@google/design.md) with lint, diff, export and spec commands, 11 lint rules including WCAG contrast checks, and exports to Tailwind v3, Tailwind v4 and W3C DTCG tokens.
contains: format: YAML design tokens + markdown design rationale
canonical sections: Overview, Colors, Typography, Layout, Elevation & Depth, Shapes, Components, Do's and Don'ts
CLI: lint, diff, export and spec commands (@google/design.md)
11 lint rules incl. broken token references, WCAG AA contrast and section order
exports: Tailwind v3 config, Tailwind v4 @theme CSS, W3C DTCG tokens.json
programmatic linter API; spec output for injecting into agent prompts
format is at alpha; Apache-2.0; 28.3k GitHub stars
